q: How do I calculate warehouse emissions per pallet position?
title: Warehouse emissions per pallet position
short: Add the warehouse electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, generator and forklift diesel at 2.68 kg per litre, and refrigerant top-ups, then divide by pallet positions. Ambient and cold warehouses differ widely, so report each type separately and share by occupied positions.

ul: Electricity for lights, racks, docks, offices and any cold rooms.
Diesel for generators and diesel forklifts.
Refrigerant top-ups for cold rooms and offices.

p: A 3PL can share the warehouse total among clients by occupied pallet positions or pallet-days. Clients report their share in Scope 3, Category 4 or 9.
Report per pallet position per month, or per pallet-day stored, and say whether it is ambient, chilled or frozen.

example.title: Worked example: ambient warehouse (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 37,108 / 8,000 = 4.638 kg CO2 per pallet position a month
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use the warehouse meter and position count.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
